name: electron v43.8.0
body:
# Release Notes for v43.8.0

## Fixes

* Fixed a crash on Linux at startup or on theme change with GTK modules loaded. [#55016](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55016)
* Fixed a crash when creating a framed window on Wayland in environments where GTK could not initialize. [#54893](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54893) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54420), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54399))</sup>
* Fixed a Linux crash creating a window with a menu bar when GTK failed to load. [#54884](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54884) <sup>(Also in [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54859), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54846))</sup>
* Fixed an issue where clicks posted to a background app were dropped on macOS. [#54905](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54905) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54906), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54819), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54818))</sup>
* Fixed `net.fetch` and `session.fetch` failing permanently with `net::ERR_FAILED` after the Network Service process restarts. [#54908](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54908) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54925), [44](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54909), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54910))</sup>
* Fixed `utilityProcess` dropping messages posted with `process.parentPort.postMessage()` right before the process exits. [#54962](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54962) <sup>(Also in [42](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55000), [45](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/54956))</sup>

## Other Changes

* Backported fixes from upstream Chromium and V8. [#55032](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55032)
* Updated Node.js to v24.22.0. [#55003](https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/55003)
